claims.text: The resort is set on the north-eastern cape of Tanjung Rhu on the Andaman Sea.

findings.quote: Set on one of the island's best beaches on the north-eastern cape of Tanjung Rhu on the Andaman Sea

claims.text: The resort is nestled within the Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark.

findings.quote: Resort is set within the Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark.

claims.text: The resort has a mile-long private beach.

findings.quote: Mile-long private beach with unobstructed view of the Andaman Sea

claims.text: The design is inspired by a blend of Moorish architecture and a traditional Malay kampung, or village, setting.

findings.quote: Inspired by a blend of Moorish architecture and traditional Malay "kampung" or village setting, with pavilions and villas blending Asian and Arabic influences

claims.text: Ikan-Ikan serves Malaysian cuisine.

findings.quote: Sip a cocktail at Rhu Bar, indulge in Malaysian cuisine at Ikan-Ikan or savour Josper-grilled seafood at Kelapa Grill.

claims.text: Kelapa Grill serves fresh local seafood and flame-grilled steaks at night.

findings.quote: By day, savour a variety of international favourites and by night, indulge in fresh local Langkawi seafood and flame-grilled steaks.
findings.note: Seafood and flame-grilled steaks by night

claims.text: The Geo Spa has six treatment rooms.

findings.quote: Across six treatment rooms, our personalized massages, facials, Ayurveda and body treatments are tailored to your needs and inspired by the island’s natural energy.

claims.text: The resort has two pools.

findings.quote: One very smart design decision contributes to this—the two main pools—one adults only, and one for families—are situated on opposite ends of the property.
findings.note: Two pools; d1 also lists Number of Pools: 2

claims.text: Beach Villa with Pool is a private oceanfront villa.

findings.quote: These beautiful and private oceanfront villas are made for couples or families seeking a perfect beach holiday with plenty of room to roam around, with a Langkawi private pool at your doorstep.
findings.note: Beach Villa with Pool described as private oceanfront villas

claims.text: The resort has an infinity-edge lap pool overlooking the Andaman Sea, with private cabanas.

findings.quote: Infinity-edge lap pool overlooking the Andaman Sea with private cabanas

claims.text: The resort is a sanctuary for several tropical bird species, including hornbills.

findings.quote: Nestled within the Langkawi UNESCO Global Geopark, our Resort is a sanctuary for several tropical bird species, including hornbills.

claims.text: The Mangroves and Eagles Safari is a three-hour mangrove river safari guided by a Four Seasons naturalist.

findings.quote: Guided by a Four Seasons naturalist, this mangrove river safari takes you on a deep tour of UNESCO Kilim Karst Geoforest Park in Langkawi, known for its rich biodiversity and limestone formations.

claims.text: Cooking classes let guests learn about Malaysian cuisine with a local chef.

findings.quote: Cooking classes allow guests to learn about Malaysian cuisine with guidance from a local chef

claims.text: Kids for All Seasons is a supervised program in a dedicated facility.

findings.quote: Supervised program in a dedicated facility, including kids' yoga and spa treatments, sea kayaking and other sports, games and adventures

claims.text: The resort is approximately 25 minutes by car from Langkawi International Airport.

findings.quote: We are located approximately 25 minutes away by car.

claims.text: The resort is approximately a 30-minute drive from Kuah Town, Langkawi's main commercial centre.

findings.quote: Resort is approximately a 30-minute drive from Kuah Town, Langkawi’s main commercial centre.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires additional travel planning.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
